purpose: Make DWG POINT and LINE writer admission reject non-finite modeled fields already rejected by their DWG readers.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: LINE carries start/end coordinates, thickness and extrusion. POINT carries point, thickness, extrusion and X-axis angle.
authority.consistencyEvidence: The corresponding DWG parsers already reject non-finite values for every field guarded in this slice.

implementation.behavior: POINT output requires finite position, thickness, extrusion and X-axis angle. LINE output requires finite start/end coordinates, thickness and extrusion. Validation precedes staging.
implementation.scope: Writer admission only; parser behavior and finite zero extrusion compatibility remain unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Each failure preserves a seeded destination. Corrected same-writer output reads back typed fields with zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All files are generated locally from scratch in test storage; no fixture was added.

limitations: Generated writer admission and readback do not establish physical producer prevalence, native rendering or whole-document qualification.
The broader P6 version/schema/no-loss audit remains open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes bounded finite-field writer gaps for DWG POINT and LINE; no broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
